floor.description: Preview a sales-order shipment. Read-only: cannot dispatch or commit. Show quantities, shortages and warnings to the operator.

mode.description: Preview only; no save tool is available.

backfill.description: Set true only for an intentional occurred_at more than 14 days old. The entry will be marked backfilled.
